label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God planted a _____ eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verse: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
note: The first real estate in Scripture — a garden 'eastward in Eden,' planted by God himself.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my _____.
verse: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
note: God's tabernacle among them: I will be their God, they shall be my people — the covenant in one sentence.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of _____: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verse: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
note: Paul's spiritual alarm clock: it's high time to awake out of sleep — salvation is nearer than when we believed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all _____: is there any thing too hard for me?
verse: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
note: God's answer to Jeremiah, who had just bought a field in a city about to fall: nothing is too hard for me.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For whom the LORD loveth he _____; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verse: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
note: Correction as a love language: 'whom the LORD loveth he correcteth' — as a father the son he delights in.
